floor_source: LEMD measured METAR; replaces upstream Forecast-API floor and defines a separately named adaptation
buckets: all integer cells [k-0.5,k+0.5), no truncated support
missing_family_policy: no prediction; never substitute deterministic maxima or silently use climatology-only
evidence_policy: diagnostic snapshot replay is not prospective OOS; a future collector must freeze before cutoff and independently audit historical evidence
station_mode: manual city mode, fixed airport coordinates; no unverified nearest-station offset or Kalshi auto-calibration
